book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso kaasɛ joo yi tu mbvuuŋ
Aju gɛ̀ bu atade, bo gee ŋka wu bvuguu a kilaantɛŋ kì Kana kimbe kì Galalee le, bwe Jiso gɛ̀ bee fo.
Bo gɛ̀ be Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo fɛ ŋka wɛɛ le.
Mbvuuŋ gɛ̀ ka, bwe Jiso be wu wu du lɛ, “Gɛ mbvuuŋ baaŋ yu gɛ.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Kwɛse, wo bege mɛ yu nje la? Kife kaŋ baaŋ a kojɛ gɛ.”

content: Bwee jɛmɛ bamii ba gabe le lɛ, “Fiɛɛ fichii fì wu lé wu jɛ̂me lɛ bɛŋ ge, bɛŋ ge.”

Gɛ̀ bee sháaŋ lɛme fo bvusoo yì bo kɛnyɛ bɛ ata. Sháaŋ chinɛ le yì Bajuu gɛ̀ gɛɛde joo yì bo chuge ye yu ki bo yuude a Nyo jii. Shaaŋ yimimia gɛ̀ jode joo njɛ baleta mbambvusooshwi ncho batɛŋ (75) gɛɛne bude baleta gwii kicho yuufe ncho batɛŋ (115).
Jiso ja wu jɛmɛ bamii ba gabe baa le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ tuu joo bɛŋ yisɛ a sháaŋ chiɛɛ le.”

content: Bo mo bo tuu joo bo yisɛ a sháaŋ yiyu le.
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ sɛɛ yimi mɛɛse bɛŋ gɛɛŋ bɛ yi fɛ chiji gabe le.”

content: Bo sɛɛ bo gɛɛŋ bɛ yi.

Chiji gabɛ fi, wu moŋ joo yiyu wu yu yi nyu yi tu wa mbvuuŋ. Wu ma laa manɛ mbvuuŋ ja faane la. (Geenɛ, bamii ba gabe ba gɛ̀ sɛlɛ joo yiyu gɛ̀ kee fɛ mo gɛ̀ ja fo.) Chiji gabe mo wu tɛɛŋ chiji bvuguu,
wu biih wu le lɛ, “Bamii to bo ya bo ga nyume mbvuuŋ ma joŋe fwe fɛ ŋka le, sege bamii mu wa bo fuu, fɛ bo gade ma joŋe, wo tu wo gɛɛ fiuŋ mbvuuŋ ma joŋe wo to bɛ mo nyu mɛɛse?”

Finɛ gɛ̀ bee fiɛɛ fì fwe fi duunyi bvukugɛ bvu Jiso fì wu gɛ̀ ge antɛnɛɛ a mwɛɛ mu duunyi bvukugɛ bwe. Wu gɛ̀ ge fiɛɛ finɛ a kilaantɛŋ kì Kana kimbe kì Galalee le. No wu ge noo, fi mo fi duunyi bvukugɛ bwe, booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo leese fitele yi ye ye le.
Ajiŋ ayu, Jiso ja wu boh Kafanahum bɛ bwee mo booŋ ba bwee ba bilɛŋsɛ mo booŋ be ba ŋgoo, bɛ bo che yo aju shige.
Jiso kuŋ bamii ba waaŋ fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ yi Nyo le
Aju a Ŋka wu Bajuu wu ba tɛŋe lɛ Ndaŋfe gɛ̀ too wa mbebe le, Jiso ja wu bɛɛŋ Yɛlusalɛm.
Wu gɛɛŋ wu bu fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu yɛŋ bamii ba gɛ̀ gese banaa bɛ shóŋ mo bimbɛmbɛ mo ba gɛ̀ kuse bige bo shiiyɛ.
Wu jo bakfuu wu kɛnyɛ ŋgwaŋ yu, wu kuŋ bo bachii yu, wu kuŋ mo shóŋ bɛ banaa wu bvusɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le. Wu ka wu taashɛ bige bi bamii gɛ̀ kuse, wu bajɛ bidaŋ biboo,
wu jɛmɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ gese bimbɛmbɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ jô mwɛɛ munɛ bɛŋ jâ yu fɛnɛ! Keefɛ bɛŋ jô yeh yi Chii tu yeh yi waaŋ gɛ!”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo kwajɛ fiɛɛ fì ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le lɛ, “Kiŋkoŋɛ kì baaŋ kì ŋkɛme fɛ yeh yo le taŋlo ki yuuyɛ lo mɛ.”
Bikwɛɛ bi Bajuu mo bi biih wu le lɛ, “Fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvukugɛ bwuŋ fì wo taŋlo wo ge fi dunyɛ bee le lɛ ba le ba nya bvuŋga wo le ki wo gêe finɛ le la.”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ sâ yeh yi kintanyɛ yinɛ, ŋkaasɛ njo aju atade yi lɛɛŋ we.”

content: Bajuu baa biih wu le lɛ, “Fi gɛ̀ jo biluŋ mbaanyɛ ncho bvusoo ki bo jooŋ yeh yi kintanyɛ yinɛ, wo lɛ wo lé wo jô fiuŋ nyu aju atade yi lɛɛŋ we?”
Geenɛ, Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme yeh yi kintanyɛ yinɛ nyu ye ye.
Noo, sege wu gɛ̀ bu wa yi kwe le, booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo kwajɛ fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ. Bo mo bo bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì le a Ŋwa wu Nyo le, bo ka bo bɛɛŋ njɛmɛ wù Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme le.
No Jiso gɛ̀ bee Yɛlusalɛm fɛ Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe wunɛ le, bamii ba duude gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele ye ye le nje mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvukugɛ bwe mù wu gɛ̀ gee.
Geenɛ, Jiso gɛ̀ baaŋ gɛɛ gɛ fie bvufee bwe yi bo le gɛ, nje wu gɛ̀ kee bamii bachii no bo le.
Wu gɛ̀ baaŋ koŋ gɛ lɛ muh mu she wu sɛŋe lo wu le kune muh wu wuŋ gɛ, nje wu kibɛɛ gɛ̀ kee fiɛɛ fì muh wu wuŋ kɛme a wu shɛŋ.
